title: Rolling supervisor goes idle: no watcher, no dispatch, mode ENDED while session alive
facts: 2026-10-30 operator asked 'rolling super sessions status, how many ran, why are you not running anything, why is work not moving'. Supervisor C ran 1 session (compacted twice), 0 successors. The 02:41Z headless wake failed (expired OAuth login) and was retired in d3570f13b with no replacement, so nothing re-engages the supervisor after a quiet period. The supervisor answered 'idle, nothing needed' for about 8 hours while 3 JIS-NB cards were READY, a signal from A (run bb_state_study.py) sat unacted, login B's supervisor had been ENDED 15 h, and 111 cards were blocked. mts_signal shows login C sup=ENDED while the session was alive. No supervisor.py wait watcher was armed after compaction. Standing operator order 'keep working for next 8 hours' was not honored.
required_fix: (a) A supervisor never ends a turn idle while READY cards exist for its lane or signals await it: dispatch a worker or arm supervisor.py wait.
(b) After compaction the supervisor re-arms the watcher and re-reads signals as its first act.
(c) Status must show per-login supervisor mode, last dispatch time, and flag 'idle with ready work' as RED.
(d) Mode must not read ENDED while the session is alive.
(e) A doctor check (MTS doctor) that flags a login with READY cards and no worker activity for 60 min.
